bloch-sphere.description: Interactive Bloch sphere; map theta/phi/statevector data to a vector, great circles, axes and basis markers.

quantum-network.description: 3D nodes/links for quantum-network and entanglement-distribution lessons.

quantum-circuit.description: Declarative SVG circuit renderer driven by quantumCircuit.operations.

quantum-data-plot.description: Histograms, probability bars, expectation values, density matrices and information-theoretic plots.

wave-interference.description: Wavefunction, interference, tunneling and probability-density plots.

timeline.description: Interactive historical timeline with zoom/filter support.

energy-levels.description: Energy-level diagrams, transitions and thermodynamic state illustrations.

linear-algebra.description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvectors and tensor-product diagrams.

concept-map.description: Generic concept/relationship visualization used when no specialized physics renderer is required.
